provider_evidence_records.field_family: Massive/Polygon all-tickers reference data for ticker discovery, active status, delisted flag semantics, date filter, exchange, CIK, and FIGI identifiers.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/all-tickers. Provider docs show /v3/reference/tickers with active, date, exchange, CIK, FIGI, delisted_utc, and plan history/recency fields. This verifies the Massive docs page was accessible; it does not independently prove Polygon-to-Massive rebrand.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: WebFetched on 2026-05-28 at https://polygon.io/terms/market_data_terms.pdf. Market-data terms impose personal/non-commercial, display, redistribution, third-party-provider, and non-professional/professional classification constraints that require authorization review.

missing_required_evidence: Actual coverage counts for active and inactive US common equities across the intended backtest window.
Ticker-change, merger, bankruptcy, OTC transition, ADR, ETF, fund, preferred, and SPAC classification policy.
CUSIP or durable cross-provider identifier handling because the docs state CUSIP is queryable but not returned.
Authorization confirmation for private local storage, derived reports, and non-display research use.

License and market-data terms remain a production blocker.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Norgate US historical daily EOD data, survivorship-bias-free market coverage, delisted stock inclusion by subscription tier, dividends, capital events, and major-exchange listing indicators.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: Provider docs state Norgate specializes in survivorship-bias-free US/AU/CA stock markets, provides historical daily EOD updates, and does not provide live, delayed, intraday, or tick data.
Provider docs state US delisted stocks require Platinum or Diamond subscription and document dividends, capital events, and US major-exchange listing indicators.
Provider docs state access is via supported plugins/APIs including Python on Windows and that delisted-security subscription level is required for survivorship-bias-free testing.

missing_required_evidence: Actual subscription tier, cost ceiling, local Windows dependency, Python integration, and export limitations review.
Coverage count for the intended US long / short / burst universe and exact common-equity eligibility filters.
License review for local derived reports, database retention after subscription lapse, and private analysis use.
Reconciliation against SEC CIK/ticker mapping and any separate fundamentals provider.
limitations: Norgate is a strong candidate for survivorship-aware historical EOD research, but it is not a live quote or intraday data source.
The docs indicate proprietary local storage and subscription-dependent access; this requires user-approved cost and license review before implementation.

provider_evidence_records.field_family: Norgate historical US index constituent and listing-status evidence for S&P, Nasdaq, and Russell proxy membership, including Russell 1000 / 2000 / Micro Cap superset data.

evidence_source_refs.evidence_note: Provider docs list US historical index constituent datasets, including Russell 1000/2000/Micro Cap supersets and notes on completeness and index reconstitution edge cases.
Provider FAQ states historical index membership is available to subscribers at Platinum level or above through linked back-testing/analysis platforms and answers membership as-of a day.

missing_required_evidence: Direct Russell 1000 benchmark return series provider and total-return construction method.
Exact membership availability through the Python/Windows path and whether row-level membership history can be exported for project lineage.
Licensing and retention terms for derived benchmark-sensitive evidence reports.
Reconciliation with final benchmark policy and ETF proxy fallback when direct index returns are unavailable.
limitations: This is membership and listing evidence, not final benchmark-return evidence.
The provider docs note index-membership access is subscription/platform dependent; implementation cannot rely on it without a later reviewed access test.

Fetch, filing, event, or benchmark availability latency exceeds the lane's reviewed evidence window.
Provider field names, units, meanings, endpoints, or documented semantics change.
As-of eligibility, filing observed date, announcement date, or latest-only status becomes ambiguous.
Listing, delisting, ADR, SPAC, ETF, ST, suspension, or security-master coverage changes.
Split, dividend, restatement, revised fundamentals, or adjustment behavior changes.
Market calendar, holiday, half-day, timezone, pre-market, after-hours, or benchmark alignment changes.
License scope, local-storage permission, quota, cost, or throttling changes.
Provider outage, retry instability, delayed data, or incident notice affects required evidence.
Outlier rate, revision rate, zero-volume anomalies, or return spikes exceed reviewed expectations.
